today.title: Today
today.description: Pickups and returns for today, overdue bikes and what is coming up. Mark bikes picked up or returned here.
today.emptyHint: Set up your fleet and share the booking page; reservations will show up here.
today.noUpcoming: No upcoming reservations in the next days.
today.windowHint: Shows the next 7 days; see Orders for everything else.

order.cancelConfirm: Cancel this order and free the bikes?
order.awaitingEmail: Waiting for the customer to confirm by email. Released at {{time}} if not confirmed.
order.notConfirmedInTime: Not confirmed by {{time}}. The reservation is released and the bikes are free again.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Every reservation of the last 90 days and the coming season. Click a row for details and actions.
orders.searchPlaceholder: Search name, email or order number
orders.emptyHint: Try another filter or search term.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Bike types your customers choose from, with sizes, prices and the physical bikes behind them.
fleet.emptyHint: Add a type such as City bike or E-bike, then add the bikes you own.

type.editHint: Customers see the name, photo, sizes and price per day.
type.editHintProducts: Customers see the name, photo, sizes and the price for each product.
type.name: Name
type.descriptionPlaceholder: Short text shown on the booking page
type.sizesHint: Comma separated. Leave empty if this type has no sizes.
type.bufferHint: Time a bike is unavailable after a return, for cleaning or charging.
type.deleteBlocked: This type has orders and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.

errors.maxDays: Max days must be at least the minimum.

type.productPricesHint: Leave a field empty if this type is not offered for that product.
type.basePriceProductsHint: Used only if the shop has no active products.
type.noProductsHint: Selling a half day or a full day? Add them under Rental settings first. Then you can set a price for each one here.
type.unbookableTitle: Guests cannot book this type yet
type.unbookableHint: Add a price for {{products}}. Until then the booking page shows this type as not offered.

rules.title: Pricing rules
rules.hint: Rules replace the price per day on matching days. Date rules win over weekday rules; the first match from the top applies.
rules.empty: No rules: the price per day applies every day.
rules.productsNote: Pricing rules change the price per day. They do not apply while the shop sells products.
rules.productsNoteKept_one: Pricing rules change the price per day. They do not apply while the shop sells products; the {{count}} rule of this type is kept.
rules.productsNoteKept_other: Pricing rules change the price per day. They do not apply while the shop sells products; the {{count}} rules of this type are kept.

errors.rule_needs_price: Every rule needs a price or a multiplier.
errors.rule_needs_dates: Date rules need a from and to date.
errors.rule_dates_order: The to date is before the from date.

units.addHint: {{count}} bikes exist for this type. New bikes are numbered on from the last one.
units.deleteBlocked: This bike has bookings and cannot be deleted. Retire it instead.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Each row is one bike, each column a day. Click a booking to open it, click a maintenance block to release it.
calendar.blockHint: Take one bike out of availability, for example for repairs.
calendar.noUnitsHint: Add bikes on the Fleet page.

settings.title: Rental settings
settings.description: How reservations work for your shop. Opening hours, contact details and branding live under My Space.
settings.publicPageHint: Customers reserve bikes online and pay at pickup.
settings.reserveModeNote: Online payment is coming in the next phase; until then every reservation is paid at pickup.
settings.dayDefinitionCalendarHint: Pickup and return on the same date is one day; every date touched counts.
settings.dayDefinition24hHint: Every started 24 hours from pickup counts as a day.
settings.noShowHint: A reservation nobody picked up this long after its start frees the bikes automatically.
settings.holdHint: How long bikes stay reserved until the customer confirms by email. Later also the time to pay online.
settings.cancellationPolicyPlaceholder: e.g. Free cancellation until the day before pickup.
settings.cancellationPolicyHint: Shown on the booking page and on the customer's order page.
settings.hoursNote: Pickup and return times follow your opening hours ({{open}}:00 to {{close}}:00).
settings.invalidNoShow: Release hours must be between 0 and 168.
settings.invalidHold: The hold must be between 5 and 1440 minutes.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change the rental settings.
settings.hoursNoteProducts: Customers book your products, so pickup and return times come from the product times.

products.title: Products
products.hint: With products, customers pick a date and one option, such as Half day 09:00–13:00. Without products, they pick any pickup and return time within your opening hours.
products.empty: No products yet. Customers choose free pickup and return times.
products.name: Name
products.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Existing orders keep their price.
products.duplicate: Another active product already uses these times.
products.pricesHint: Set the price of each product per bike type under Fleet.
products.unpricedTitle: Guests cannot book these bike types yet
products.unpricedHint: No price is set for any product: {{types}}. Add the prices under Fleet.
